PAS is Pathetic Acceleration Syndrome

What Causes Pathetic Acceleration Syndrome? The exact cause of P.A.S. is not known. However, the fact that it tends to run in certain vehicles like the Honda CRV, Toyota RAV4, Prius and PT Cruiser and other cars shaped like this leads us to believe that consumer reports is a carrier. We believe that P.A.S. relates to less of a joy of driving and more of a "How much of a mindless, seflish fuck can i be while getting to point b?"

How Common Is PAS? PAS recently has been recognized as a unique disorder. It can be spotted primarily at stop lights, intersections and anywhere other people are trying to get somewhere in a timely manner.

How Is PAS Diagnosed? You can evaluate PAS by looking for intersections where there are more than 1 lane. Invariably, a driver with PAS will take an empty lane even though they have no intention of accelerating faster than the Bus or dump truck that is right beside them. Side effects are everyone else is stuck behind this driver that is accelerating at geological speeds. If it takes you 30 seconds to reach the speed limit from a light, you might be affected by PAS.

How Is PAS Treated? Unfortunately, there is no cure for PAS while the host is driving any of the following vehicles: Toyota Prius PT Cruiser Honda CR-V Toyota Rav4

Even then, most drivers affected by PAS will never give up these vehicles, even after 500,000 miles.

Special education: It's possible to let them ride in a BMW, Audi or other car that is able to accelerate. This may enlighten them.

Behavior modification: Many claim the finger is a suitable response but this just makes the driver more erratic and less focused on actually driving.
P.A.S. is real and it affects everyone

Please help get the word out on this terrible affliction.
